say:1:1310204001:0.text: Hello travelers! In this chilly weather, wouldn't you like to warm up with some hot food?
say:1:1310204001:0.source_cn: 各位远道而来的朋友，天气这样寒冷，要不要来吃些热气腾腾...

say:3:1310204002:0.text: Oh! This is my favorite restaurant in all of Cedartown. They've got my favorite dessert bread!
say:3:1310204002:0.source_cn: 哦嚯！这家餐厅可是雪松镇里我最喜欢的地方了。哎呀，有我...

say:4:1310204003:0.text: The bread's covered in syrup and stuffed with fresh berry jam. So good! Here, have a bite.
say:4:1310204003:0.source_cn: 这种裹了糖浆的面包圈里面填满了新鲜浆果做成的果酱，棒极...

say:7:1310204004:0.text: Mhmm, so sweet and tangy. Yummy! Hugin, you sure know your way around Cedartown's food!
say:7:1310204004:0.source_cn: 嗯……唔……酸甜可口，好吃！呼金先生，原来你对雪松镇的...

say:8:1310204005:0.text: Haha! I came here years ago. I didn't make it for the festival, but the food... unforgettable. I remember there was also this stuffed bread...
say:8:1310204005:0.source_cn: 哈！很多年前我来过这里，虽然没赶上祭典，但可是大饱了口...

say:11:1310204006:0.text: You must be talking about our famous savory bread!
say:11:1310204006:0.source_cn: 这位客人，你说的一定是我家餐厅最出名的烤炉面包吧！

say:12:1310204007:0.text: Yes! Fresh out of the oven, topped with sausage, veggies, and cheese. I still dream about that taste...
say:12:1310204007:0.source_cn: 就是它！热乎乎的炉子里现烤出来的、上面堆满了香肠、蔬菜...

say:13:1310204008:0.text: Oh wow... That gooey cheese, the warm bread, and the aroma of those toppings filling my nose. Even Hardhead's drooling!
say:13:1310204008:0.source_cn: 喔……瞧这能拉出丝来的浓香奶酪，配上烤面包的麦香、香肠...

say:16:1310204009:1.text: Mhmm! It's too good! Now if only we had something to drink...
say:16:1310204009:1.source_cn: 唔唔，太好吃了！如果能再有些喝的……

say:17:1310204010:0.text: We've got mushroom and meat stew, or a clear chicken soup with snowradish and frosted celery. Tastes just like home!
say:17:1310204010:0.source_cn: 当然有啦！各种蘑菇和肉炖出来的蘑菇汤，或者是放了雪葱萝...

say:20:1310204011:0.text: A warm bowl in this cold weather? It's just like curling up by a fire!
say:20:1310204011:0.source_cn: 这样寒冷的冬天里喝上一碗，热乎乎，和靠在火炉边睡觉一样舒服！

say:21:1310204012:0.text: It smells amazing! Magister, you gotta try some too!
say:21:1310204012:0.source_cn: 真是、真是太香了！！！主人，你也尝尝！
say:21:1310204012:0.male: It smells amazing! Magister, you gotta try some too!
say:21:1310204012:0.female: It smells amazing! Magister, you gotta try some too!
